purpose: Define the PR evidence, release path, deploy smoke evidence, and rollback metadata required before release-sensitive changes land or promote.

required_evidence: Changed files and affected runtime or process surfaces.
Risk classification with rationale and protected-surface impact.
Exact verification commands with pass, fail, blocked, or skipped status.
Contract validation evidence for machine-readable release or work-item artifacts.
Deploy or smoke evidence for release-impacting changes, or an explicit credential/environment blocker.
Reviewer checklist for auth, billing, tenancy, audit, webhook, approval, schema, deploy, and public-claim surfaces when touched.
ready_done_confirmation: Definition of Ready was met before implementation, or gaps are named in the PR.
Definition of Done is met before merge, or blockers and next safe steps are named in the PR.
Runtime behavior, dependencies, migrations, workflows, and deploy behavior are unchanged or explicitly described.
release_path: Work lands on a scoped branch.
A PR carries evidence, risk, rollout, rollback, and residual-risk notes.
Required local or CI checks pass, or a blocker-specific substitute is documented and approved.
Production-sensitive changes deploy to staging before production promotion where credentials permit.
Production promotion records smoke, health, and rollback-target evidence.

release.rollback_action: Redeploy the last known-good Cloudflare worker versions for web, api, and workflows, then rerun npm run smoke:cloudflare.

service_targets.required_target: Last known-good concrete Cloudflare Worker version ID or Cloudflare dashboard rollback target UUID for the web surface.
service_targets.post_rollback_check: Run npm run smoke:cloudflare and confirm the web health or route smoke result.

service_targets.required_target: Last known-good concrete Cloudflare Worker version ID or Cloudflare dashboard rollback target UUID for the api surface.
service_targets.post_rollback_check: Run npm run smoke:cloudflare and confirm /health responds successfully.

service_targets.required_target: Last known-good concrete Cloudflare Worker version ID or Cloudflare dashboard rollback target UUID for workflows.
service_targets.post_rollback_check: Run npm run smoke:cloudflare and confirm workflow smoke or health evidence when workflows are in scope.

required_target_fields: worker_version_id, version_id, target_version_id, or Cloudflare dashboard target containing a UUID
rollback_command containing wrangler rollback, the concrete target ID, and the service wrangler config path, or a Cloudflare dashboard rollback target containing the target ID

required_fields: affected Cloudflare services: web, api, workflows, or explicit none for metadata-only changes
service-specific release.rollback_action JSON targets with concrete Worker version IDs or Cloudflare dashboard target UUIDs for every affected Cloudflare service
rollback_metadata.metadata_only_exception: For metadata-only changes with no deployed service impact, state that no Cloudflare service rollback is required and the PR can be closed or reverted.

rollback_metadata_required: affected Cloudflare services: web, api, workflows, or explicit none for metadata-only changes
last known-good Worker version IDs or dashboard rollback targets for every affected Cloudflare service
abort_conditions: billing checkout, portal, or webhook verification fails
dashboard truth is wrong or unavailable
approval-required workflow can dispatch without approval
public pricing or claims become materially inaccurate

required_for_release: CI or local substitute gate results.
Staging deploy result for production-sensitive changes where credentials permit.
npm run smoke:cloudflare result or blocked reason.
Healthcheck status for API and web surfaces.
Workflow healthcheck status when workflows are in scope.
Production deploy workflow metadata validation result for the selected service set.
Rollback target confirmation for Cloudflare web, api, and workflows before production promotion, or an explicit metadata-only no-service-rollback note.
deploy_evidence.credential_blocker_policy: If Cloudflare credentials or environment variables are unavailable, record the missing prerequisite and do not claim deploy or smoke success.
